audit.whatIsWrong: The FULL level chart and the content win[] chart both hand Mordekaiser levels 3 through two-items, which contradicts the entry's own prose and the 57.39% Emerald+ win rate over 1157 games.
audit.why: content whys[3] literally says "these two levels of free farming gold are the reason this matchup is FAVOURED" while win[3] reads "Mordekaiser"; whys[5] and whys[6] describe an unstoppable Singed while win[5] and win[6] also read "Mordekaiser". The audit packet's levelChart is Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Singed / Mordekaiser / Singed / Singed, which matches the prose exactly.
audit.corrected: Early (1-3): standoff then Mordekaiser, once Indestructible and Darkness Rise are online. Mid (4-5): Singed — a dashless Mordekaiser cannot chase a proxy. Level 6: Mordekaiser. Side lane and teamfights from first item on: Singed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes are described without a single cooldown number, and Mordekaiser's level-2 Indestructible spike is missed entirely in the FULL layer.
audit.why: Riot's data gives Realm of Death 140/120/100s at 650 range, Death's Grasp 16/14/12/10/8s at 700 range and Indestructible 12/11/10/9/8s. Those numbers are what make "trade around his cooldown" actionable.
audit.corrected: Mordekaiser spikes: level 2 Indestructible, level 3 Darkness Rise + Death's Grasp, level 6 Realm of Death (140/120/100s). Singed spikes: levels 4-5 proxy window, level 6 Insanity Potion (100s) for Grievous Wounds, Rylai's first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability claims are wrong. content.late says to "keep 650 units between you and his E" — 650 is Realm of Death's range, Death's Grasp is 700. And both late and whys[6] claim his W "does nothing against persistent poison attrition".
audit.why: Indestructible stores damage Mordekaiser deals AND damage he takes to build the shield, then can be consumed to heal — so Poison Trail ticks actively feed it. The real counter is Insanity Potion, which makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds and cuts that heal. That interaction appears nowhere in either layer.
audit.corrected: Stay outside 700 so Death's Grasp cannot drag you back. Pop Insanity Potion before the extended trade: Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail cuts the Indestructible heal-back, which your own poison would otherwise be charging.

audit.whatIsWrong: content whys[4] states Realm of Death "steals 10% of your stats".
audit.why: Riot's description says only "steals a portion of their stats" — no percentage is given in the data, and the number is not verifiable from the kit file.
audit.corrected: Left in place rather than guessed at. If the 10% figure is not sourced, drop the number and say "steals a chunk of your stats".

audit.why: 57.39% Emerald+ over 1157 games matches the table.

edits.before: After Rylai's this lane is over in your favor. Every step through Poison Trail is a permanent slow and Mordekaiser's zero-dash kit can never close the gap — he is a sitting target for the run-past poison kite that your whole identity is built around. His R is still dangerous if he catches you without Insanity Potion up, so track its cooldown like a jungler tracks buff timers: when Realm of Death is down, force the side wave and make him react; when it is up, keep 650 units between you and his E so he cannot drag you in. Two items on, your carry threat hits 8 out of 10 — he is slower than you, his W shield does nothing against attrition poison, and he cannot follow you into a split-push angle without abandoning his team.  The longer the game goes the more it belongs to you, so do not let the early levels tilt you off the pattern that wins this.
